$description: StatusDot (platform/components/StatusDot, library wave 4, extend): the tokens of the availability tones, the larger dots and the glyph. The dot's own size, corners and feedback tones are in components.tokens.json.

status-dot-online-background.$description: StatusDot online: the person is online and available (Status colors).

status-dot-away-background.$description: StatusDot away: the person is away (Status colors).

status-dot-busy-background.$description: StatusDot busy: the person is busy, in a meeting or a call (Status colors); the solid dot, nothing cut out.

status-dot-dnd-background.$description: StatusDot do not disturb: the person asks not to be disturbed (Status colors; the busy color, told apart by the minus cut out).

status-dot-offline-background.$description: StatusDot offline: the person is offline (Status colors).

status-dot-md-size.$description: StatusDot size md: the dot's width and height, and its glyph's box (12px).

status-dot-lg-size.$description: StatusDot size lg: the dot's width and height, and its glyph's box (16px).

status-dot-glyph-color.$description: StatusDot: the glyph, cut out of the dot in the surface color.
